purpose: Consolidate scattered state management into unified lib/state module.
design_intent: Single source of truth for state types and operations. Reduce cognitive load and risk of drift between in-memory and persisted types.
change_impact: New state module is canonical source. Original files re-export for backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: lib/state/observer.ts, publisher.ts, scheduler.ts provide unified APIs
lib/controls.ts and lib/runtimeControls.ts re-export for backward compatibility

deliverables.change: New: barrel export for state module
Replaced with re-exports from lib/state (backward compatible)
